descriptionChirho: A young human child or boy, used in singular reference to a specific child.
Plural reference to young human children or boys as a group.
Older youths or young men, distinct from small children, emphasizing adolescence or young adulthood.
Children belonging to a specific person, with pronominal suffixes indicating possession (his, her, their, my children).
Offspring or young of animals, used metaphorically or literally for animal progeny.
